mapper.update: UPDATE t_coupon_task_batch SET status = 1, lease_owner = #{owner}, lease_expire_time = #{leaseExpireTime}, update_time = NOW() WHERE id = #{batchId} AND shop_number = #{shopNumber} AND ( status = 0 OR (status = 1 AND lease_expire_time < NOW()) )
mapper.select: SELECT id, task_id, shop_number, coupon_template_id, batch_no, expected_count, success_count, fail_count, status, lease_owner, lease_expire_time, create_time, update_time FROM t_coupon_task_batch WHERE id = #{batchId} AND shop_number = #{shopNumber}
mapper.update: UPDATE t_coupon_task_batch SET status = 2, success_count = #{successCount}, fail_count = #{failCount}, lease_owner = NULL, lease_expire_time = NULL, update_time = NOW() WHERE id = #{batchId} AND shop_number = #{shopNumber} AND status = 1 AND lease_owner = #{owner}
